title: BoxInst: High-Performance Instance Segmentation with Box Annotations
mechanism: Projection loss (mask max-projected on x and y must match the box) plus pairwise colour-affinity loss learn masks from boxes alone.
evidence: COCO box-only instance segmentation close to mask supervision (numbers not re-read).
adaptation: Auxiliary projection + intensity-affinity loss on the crack channel for PVEL-AD crack boxes; projection suits long thin cracks spanning the box.
min_experiment: Arm: house + PVEL-AD boxes with BoxInst loss, 5 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed and Boxes2Pixels arm. Metric: E1 crack recall, clean-49 crack relF1@2. Kill if E1 recall < +0.03. ~15 GPU-h.
